name: DK-3
description: DK-3 was an R-series astromech droid in the service of a Gran trader on Pantora. The protocol droid CG-67 supervised DK-3 and the trader's other droids, fellow astromech 225 and the LE-series Clink. DK-3 and the other droids assisted in repairing the Marauder, the shuttle of the former clone trooper unit known as the Bad Batch.
